## Description

A testate amoeba with an ovoid test (45–100 µm) made of oval silica scales with spines, in moss and
peat bogs. It does not constrict like a naked amoeba: the daughter's cytoplasm leaves through the
aperture, builds its test with the scales the mother keeps in reserve and separates.

## In the simulation

<!-- GENERATED:presence -->
Drops: `moss` (weight 1), `pond` (weight 0.15), `puddle` (weight 0.15); 3 individuals in a reference drop at weight 1.
<!-- /GENERATED -->

`testate = "filose"`: [rigid test](../../mechanics/soft-bodies.md) with filose pseudopods through the aperture;
reproduction as [budding](../../mechanics/life-cycle-and-division.md). Spines are covering processes on the edges
of the flattened test (length and number estimated). Common in the moss biome.
